references.text: The psalm mentions Mount Zalmon (Tsalmon), the same mountain Abimelech climbed to gather branches for burning down the tower in Shechem.
The continuation of the story where the people follow Abimelech's example and cut branches to burn the tower in Shechem.
The context of Abimelech's attack on Shechem, where he captured the city and killed its inhabitants.
Joshua built an altar on Mount Ebal and led the people, an example of a leader who goes ahead and shows the way for others to follow.
Gideon, Abimelech's father, also urged his men to follow his example in battle, saying, 'Look at me and do as I do!'
